# milvex v0.13.0 - Table of Contents

> An Elixir client for Milvus, the open-source vector database.

## Pages

- Guides
  - [Getting Started](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/getting-started.md)
  - [Architecture](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/architecture.md)
  - [Error Handling](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/error-handling.md)
  - [Pagination and Streaming](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/pagination_and_streaming.md)

- About
  - [Introduction](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
  - [Changelog](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
  - [License](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Milvex.AnnSearch](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.AnnSearch.md): Represents a single ANN search request for hybrid search.
- [Milvex.Collection](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.md): Declarative DSL for defining Milvus collection schemas.
- [Milvex.Collection.Dsl](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Dsl.md): Spark DSL extension for defining Milvus collection schemas.
- [Milvex.Collection.Dsl.BM25Function](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Dsl.BM25Function.md): Struct representing a BM25 function definition in the Milvex Collection DSL.
- [Milvex.Collection.Dsl.Field](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Dsl.Field.md): Struct representing a field definition in the Milvex Collection DSL.
- [Milvex.Collection.Transformers.DefineStruct](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Transformers.DefineStruct.md): Transformer that generates a struct and @type t from the Collection DSL fields.
- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.RequirePrimaryKey](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.RequirePrimaryKey.md): Verifies that exactly one primary key field is defined in the collection.

- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.UniqueFieldNames](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.UniqueFieldNames.md): Verifies that all field names in the collection are unique.

- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateArrayConfig](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateArrayConfig.md): Verifies that array fields have valid configuration.
- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateAutoId](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateAutoId.md): Verifies that auto_id is only used with int64 primary keys.
- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateCollectionName](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateCollectionName.md): Verifies that the collection name is valid according to Milvus naming rules.
- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateDynamicField](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateDynamicField.md): Verifies that dynamic fields are only used with valid scalar types.
- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateVarcharLength](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateVarcharLength.md): Verifies that varchar fields have valid max_length configuration.
- [Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateVectorDimensions](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Collection.Verifiers.ValidateVectorDimensions.md): Verifies that vector fields have valid dimensions.
- [Milvex.ExprParams](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.ExprParams.md): Converts Elixir values to Milvus `TemplateValue` protobuf structs for filter expression templating.
- [Milvex.Function](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Function.md): Builder for Milvus function schemas.
- [Milvex.Highlighter](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Highlighter.md): Builder functions for search result highlighting.
- [Milvex.OrderBy](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.OrderBy.md): Translates the `:order_by` option for `Milvex.query/4` into the Milvus
`order_by_fields` query parameter.
- [Milvex.Ranker](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Ranker.md): Builder functions for hybrid search rerankers.
- [Milvex.Ranker.DecayRanker](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Ranker.DecayRanker.md): Decay function reranker for hybrid search.
- [Milvex.Ranker.RRFRanker](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Ranker.RRFRanker.md): Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) reranker for hybrid search.
- [Milvex.Ranker.WeightedRanker](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Ranker.WeightedRanker.md): Weighted scoring reranker for hybrid search.
- [Milvex.Retry](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Retry.md): RPC-level retry logic for transient gRPC errors.
- [Milvex.SearchResult.Hit](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.SearchResult.Hit.md): Represents a single search hit.

- [Milvex.Schema.Migration](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Schema.Migration.md): Implements schema migration for Milvus collections.

- Client API
  - [Milvex](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.md): # Milvex
  - [Milvex.Connection](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Connection.md): State machine managing gRPC channel lifecycle with automatic reconnection.

- Data Builders
  - [Milvex.Data](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Data.md): Builder for Milvus insert data.
  - [Milvex.Index](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Index.md): Builder for Milvus index configurations.
  - [Milvex.Schema](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Schema.md): Builder for Milvus collection schemas.
  - [Milvex.Data.FieldData](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Data.FieldData.md): Converts between Elixir values and Milvus FieldData protobuf structures.
  - [Milvex.Schema.Field](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Schema.Field.md): Builder for Milvus collection field schemas.

- Results
  - [Milvex.QueryResult](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.QueryResult.md): Parser for Milvus query results.
  - [Milvex.SearchResult](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.SearchResult.md): Parser for Milvus search results.

- Errors
  - [Milvex.Error](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Error.md): Main error aggregator for Milvex using Splode.
  - [Milvex.Errors.Connection](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Errors.Connection.md): Errors related to connection establishment, network issues, or disconnections.
  - [Milvex.Errors.Grpc](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Errors.Grpc.md): Errors from gRPC operations or Milvus server responses.
  - [Milvex.Errors.Invalid](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Errors.Invalid.md): Errors for invalid input, validation failures, or constraint violations.
  - [Milvex.Errors.Unknown](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Errors.Unknown.md): Fallback for unexpected or unclassified errors.

- Telemetry
  - [Milvex.Telemetry](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events emitted by Milvex.

- Configuration
  - [Milvex.Backoff](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Backoff.md): Exponential backoff calculator with jitter support.
  - [Milvex.Config](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.Config.md): Configuration module for Milvus client connections.

- Internal
  - [Milvex.RPC](https://milvex.hexdocs.pm/Milvex.RPC.md): Low-level gRPC wrapper with consistent error handling.

And use it to continue the replication at source cluster.
